home.title: Web developer tools that never see your data
home.lead: Format JSON, decode JWTs, build fluid CSS or draw diagrams. Each tool runs entirely in your browser, so you can paste production tokens, certificates or customer data without fear.
home.point1Text: No backend processes your input. 0 bytes of what you paste are sent anywhere.
home.point2Text: Once a page has loaded, the tool keeps working without a connection.
home.point3Text: One tool, one page, live results as you type. Learn one, know them all.
home.toolsLead: Every entry is a concrete tool with the name you'd search for.
home.aboutTitle: Made by a web developer, for web developers
home.aboutText: kitforweb is a free, open-source side project with no ads and no trackers. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee to keep it going.
home.ogSubtitle: JSON, JWT, CSS, Mermaid and more · 100% in your browser

about.title: About
about.description: Who is behind kitforweb, why it exists and how it protects your data.
about.p1: Hi! I'm the web developer behind kitforweb. I build frontends for a living and, like you, I spend a good part of the day formatting JSON, decoding tokens and fighting with CSS.
about.p2: kitforweb gathers the small utilities I reach for every day in a single place that feels like an editor: fast, keyboard-friendly and without distractions.
about.why: Because most online tools send what you paste to their servers. That's a real problem when what you paste is a production JWT, a customer's data or a private key. Here, every tool runs in your browser.
about.privacy: The code is <repo>open source on GitHub</repo>. Open the Network tab of your browser's DevTools while you use any tool: you'll see that nothing you type is sent anywhere.
about.donateText: kitforweb is free and has no ads. If it saves you time, a one-off coffee helps pay for the domain and keeps new tools coming.
